title: vanil Gun
body:
**Mod Description:**
This mod adds vanilla-style firearms to Minecraft, designed to feel natural within the base game rather than turning it into a modern shooter. The weapons follow Minecraft’s visual style and survival balance.

**Features**:

- Simple, pixel-art designs that match vanilla Minecraft

- Balanced damage and fire rate for survival gameplay

- Simple ammo system (for example, bullets crafted with iron and gunpowder)

- Uses common in-game materials

- Works well in singleplayer and multiplayer worlds

**Purpose**:
This mod is perfect for players who want more combat variety while keeping the original Minecraft survival feeling intact.
